heroSummary: PSD’s 2026–27 school year begins with Transition Day for grades 6 and 9 on Tuesday, August 18, 2026. The first day for all schools is Wednesday, August 19, and the last day of school is Friday, May 28, 2027. Below you’ll find districtwide no-school dates, elementary-only closures, school break and return dates, and official calendar PDFs in English, Spanish, and Arabic.

whatsNew.title: What Changed from 2025–26
content: Transition Day moves from August 13 to August 18.
The first day for all schools moves from August 14 to August 19. PSD said the later start is intended to reduce potential heat-related impacts in early August.
The last day of school moves from May 27 to May 28.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Poudre School District start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Students in grades 6 and 9 attend Transition Day on Tuesday, August 18, 2026. The first day for all PSD schools is Wednesday, August 19.

calendarFaqs.q: Which PSD no-school dates apply only to elementary students?
calendarFaqs.a: September 28, October 15, and May 17 are elementary-only no-school dates. These dates do not apply to middle and high school students.

calendarFaqs.q: When are PSD fall, winter, and spring breaks?
calendarFaqs.a: Fall Break is November 23–27, 2026; Winter Break is December 21, 2026–January 4, 2027; and Spring Break is March 15–19, 2027. Classes resume November 30, January 5, and March 22, respectively.

calendarFaqs.q: Do PSD PreK programs follow the same calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Not always. PreK and Integrated Services Transition Programs may follow different calendars, so families should confirm dates with the applicable department.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can families check for PSD calendar changes?
calendarFaqs.a: Check PSD’s official calendars and schedules page, the current student calendar PDF, and your assigned school or program before making final plans.

sourceReviewSummary: This page was checked against PSD’s official 2026–27 student calendar and its Calendars & Schedules page on August 6, 2026.
sourceReviewDetails: We verified Transition Day, the all-schools first day, the last day, all-grade closures, elementary-only closures, break and return dates, quarter ranges, program exceptions, and translated PDF links.
PSD’s calendars page lists 175 elementary student contact days and 176 secondary student contact days.
The 2025–26 and 2026–27 student calendars were used for the year-over-year comparison.
Return dates are the next scheduled student attendance days after each districtwide break.
The downloadable ICS file is generated from the student dates listed on this page and does not update automatically if PSD revises its calendar.
